messages.content: Northline Care check-in — hope your week's going okay. Any blood pressure numbers to share today?
152 over 94. Been running higher than usual the past few days.

Thanks for that. I've logged the reading. 152/94 is elevated enough that I'm flagging it for your nurse — just so you know, median response time right now is 31 hours. Are you having any headache, chest tightness, or shortness of breath?
No, none of that. 31 hours? I flagged a reading last week and never heard anything back.

I hear you and I'm sorry — that's a long wait, especially out here. I can't change the queue or get you a faster response, but this flag is in and your reading is logged. I wish I could do more on that front.

Understood. I'm not able to remove you from these check-ins on my end — that's something I genuinely can't do yet. To opt out, please contact Northline Care directly or reply STOP through your carrier. I'm sorry these haven't felt useful.

theme: wants to opt out, sends STOP after a slow reply
